_sobre: Format example of Timeline, with no brand: vertical axis, four dates, the guided camera ('guiada': the whole axis, then close to each milestone as it lights up, then back), the current pill in its own color ('etiquetaAtiva') and a push upward into the closing, which is the logo alone. The dates are samples: write the true ones. Greys, placeholder texts, the placeholder logo stand for the person's brand and content: swap them. Render: node scripts/example-fonts.mjs <output>/.work-timeline-example-vertical && node templates/timeline/render.mjs templates/timeline/example-vertical.json --out <output> --mode draft
